name: Shindouji Chisato
source:
Grade: Second Year
Affiliation: Sakigake Shinken
Attributes: Tsundere swordsman, childhood friend
Problems: Weak when it comes to love, lactates
Erogenous Zone(s): Breasts in general
The only daughter of the Shinken dojo, Shunosuke is her sponger.
While she is very fashionable on one hand, on the other, she is a serious and unyielding girl forged in envy.
Her tone is tough, but she means well. She is also caring towards underclassman.
It is thought Shunosuke is part of her dojo, as he was trained by her father. She is shy when it comes down to love.
Looking at the silly, perverse behavior of Shunosuke, she is often jealous of the other girls, and ends up hitting him a lot.
